Name: Krobus Sells Dwarf Scrolls
Author: TheFrenchDodo
Description:
A very simple self-indulgent mod that adds the dwarf scrolls to Krobus' shop in a balanced way.

[b]How is it balanced?[/b]

- You can buy them from Krobus, which means you have donated a minimum of 60 items to the museum.
- They are pretty pricey (10,000 G each)
- Krobus sells only one per day.

That way, you can complete your dwarf scrolls collection without feeling like you cheated.


This should be compatible with everything. If you find any incompatibilities, feel free to report them!

Mod in screenshots: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19405]More Lively Sewer Overhaul[/url]
